description: This file defines the AppManager class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares the class as a plugin implementing IPlugin and JSONRPC interfaces, along with a nested Notification class for handling remote connection and app manager notifications. The file includes external dependencies, class declarations, method signatures, and internal data members related to app management and notifications.

classes.name: AppManager
classes.description: Main plugin class managing application lifecycle and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class implementing notification interfaces for remote connection and app management events, used internally by AppManager.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.
